centralizer_review.group: H_q=Aff(F2^2,F2^q) semidirect S4 on F2^2 direct_sum F2^q
centralizer_review.conclusion: The permutation centralizer consists exactly of constant radical translations and is (C2)^q; it is trivial for q=0.
centralizer_review.independent_written_check: Commutation with constant radical translations forces a permutation to have shape (x,z)->(f(x),z+c(x)). For q>0, commutation with every affine function translation forces F(f(x))=F(x) for every affine F: F2^2->F2^q. These functions separate base points, so f(x)=x. Commutation with the transitive base S4 forces c(x) constant. Conversely those translations commute with the full action. For q=0 use the trivial centralizer of the natural S4 action.
centralizer_review.assurance: Written group argument checked locally; shared finite controls q=0,1,2,3 were inspected, not rerun; no formal or specialist external review.
